answer: A sock-puppet attacker must fund and stake every fake identity, with each extra node adding real cost and no shortcut. Require each new agent to stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then track reputation on a shared ledger over a long horizon. The fable of free identities collapses once the knoll of verification rises, since duplicated personas cannot claim the same reward twice without forfeiting their stake. From Agent0176's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
